archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (Adapted for Medical Trust)
vibe: Professional, clean, highly legible, trustworthy, reducing cognitive load.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy with Control Room Grid for dashboard.
spacing_and_layout.card_style: Flat background (bg-white), 1px solid border (border-slate-200), NO shadow. Hover: slight shadow-sm.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.medical_rule: Use Flat Solid surfaces. NO Glassmorphism (prevents visual refraction of clinical data).
surfaces_and_micro_themes.header: Solid white background, border-b border-slate-200. Sticky top with z-50.

components.buttons: Flat, pure primary color (bg-sky-700), high contrast white text. Hover: bg-sky-600. No heavy shadows.
components.forms: Shadcn UI. Use clear borders, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-sky-500. Left-aligned labels.
components.tables: Compact tables, 1px border-b, hover:bg-slate-50. Highlight abnormal states clearly.
components.upload_zone: Large dropzone, p-12, border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-slate-50 hover:border-sky-500 hover:bg-sky-50 transition-colors.

image_urls.description: Empty hospital corridor for the split-screen login page background. Use with heavy dark overlay if placing text, or clear if just structural.
Doctor reviewing tablet. Use for 'No studies uploaded yet' or onboarding screens.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 ratio for text. Blue buttons must have white text.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links). Use kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., login-submit-button, dicom-upload-dropzone).

instructions_to_main_agent: Language MUST be Spanish (e.g., 'Iniciar Sesión', 'Subir Archivo DICOM', 'Pacientes', 'Médicos').
Implement Role-Based Access logic (Paciente, Clínica/Hospital, Médico Especialista) with Custom JWT Auth.
The UI is a SaaS dashboard. Use a sidebar or top-nav layout strictly following the Control Room Grid protocol.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Work Sans' or fallback to 'Manrope'.
Avoid glassmorphism completely. Use solid, flat surfaces with subtle 1px borders to maintain clinical precision and clarity.
Prioritize the Upload DICOM zone with metadata form (Patient info, assigned doctor dropdown).
Doctor view should heavily feature a well-structured data table for downloading assigned DICOMs (No viewer needed).
